story.text: France beat Morocco 2-0 in the Semi-finals of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Morocco had more of the ball (62 percent to 38 percent), and France created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (2.06 to 1.06). The goals came from Theo Hernández at 4:40 and Randal Kolo Muani at 78:49.
